analysis: The supplied units are base_text excerpts (lines 2304-3100) of docs/developer/test.md, far from the changed range (base 142-146, head 142-153). The patch shows documentation-only edits: the CI build-cache policy changes to save a build only on push to dev/master, with pull requests restoring but not saving, and a new MiMo audio gate that runs only when its inputs change or on master pushes. No runtime provider code, WebSocket contract, key handling, attestation, App Attest, prefix-cache storage (T-041), add-on hold socket (TB-012), or fan helper changes are present. The excerpted test-doc text does not touch any threat-model asset or trust boundary. One CI-related observation: restricting cache saves to push on trusted branches reduces cache-poisoning risk from PR builds, a mild improvement, and no weakening is visible. The skipped audio gate for PRs outside its inputs is a test-coverage choice, not a security control in the threat model. Remaining questions are outside the supplied evidence: whether scripts/ci-component-paths.py MIMO_AUDIO input list is complete, and whether the build.md#ci-caching text matches the workflow implementation. Neither affects a threat-model conclusion from this evidence.
